_seeding: authors = union(dedupe) of authors_derived (every corpus primary author with >=4 RETAINED papers, computed 2026-10-22 from ../export/sadb_export.json, recordType=='paper' only, archived excluded from the count) and authors_pinned (the hand-pinned core). keywords = the spec-named terms plus corpus-vocabulary picks. Deliberately NOT seeded even though the corpus mentions them: 'sensory feedback' (floods the report with haptics/VR papers) and 'spinal cord injury' (floods it with clinical SCI-management papers); 'hindlimb locomotion' and 'locomotor recovery' cover the in-corpus SCI/locomotion lane instead. First real run (2026-10-22) showed the difference: those two keywords alone produced ~40 of 53 rows, nearly all out of scope. Ben owns the list afterwards: edit 'authors'/'keywords' directly; the seed lists are provenance only.
